title: Privacy Policy
description: How JUSASOL collects, uses, stores, and protects information shared through this website.
body:
At **JUSASOL**, we believe your personal information deserves to be treated with care and respect.

When you visit our website, contact our team, or enquire about our services, you may share certain information with us. We want you to understand what happens to that information, why we need it, and how we work to keep it safe.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information shared through our website.

We have written it in straightforward language so you can understand our practices without having to work through complicated legal terms.

## 1. About Us

JUSASOL is a software development company based in the United States. We help businesses build practical technology solutions, including artificial intelligence (AI) applications, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, and custom websites.

Our business contact details are:

**JUSASOL**
207 Chapel Rd
Black Mountain, NC 28711, USA

**Email:** {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}
**Phone:** {{COMPANY_PHONE}}

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, you are always welcome to get in touch.

## 2. Information We Collect

We collect information that helps us communicate with you, understand your needs, and provide our services.

Most of the information we receive comes directly from you.

### Information you share with us

When you fill out a contact form, send us a message, or enquire about a project, we may ask for:

- Your name and business email address
- Your company or organisation name
- Your phone number, if you choose to provide it
- The service you are interested in
- A description of your project or requirements
- Your estimated project budget, if you wish to share it
- Any additional details included in your message

We use this information to understand what you are looking for and to respond in a useful way.

You do not need to provide optional details, such as your phone number or project budget, unless you want to.

### Messages to our leadership team

Our website allows visitors to contact members of our leadership team.

If you use this feature, we may receive your name, email address, the person you want to contact, and your message.

Choosing Get in touch on a leadership card opens the leadership form and selects that person. The other fields stay empty for you to complete. Please use your own email address.

### Information collected automatically

Like most websites, ours may collect basic technical information when you visit.

This can include your IP address, browser type, operating system, pages requested, and the time of your visit.

Our hosting provider may also keep server logs to help identify technical problems, maintain website performance, and detect suspicious activity.

This information is primarily used to keep the website working properly and securely.

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to communicate with you and support our day-to-day business activities.

For example, we may use it to:

- Respond to your questions or project enquiries
- Understand your business needs and recommend suitable services
- Discuss potential projects and prepare for future collaborations
- Connect you with the appropriate person on our team
- Manage communications related to ongoing projects
- Maintain and improve our website
- Identify technical issues or potential security concerns
- Meet applicable legal obligations

If you contact us about a project, we may keep the relevant messages as part of our business records if the conversation develops into a client relationship.

**We do not sell your personal information.**

We also do not add information submitted through our contact forms to unrelated marketing lists.

Our intention is simple: if you share information with us for a particular reason, we use it for that reason and other compatible, lawful business purposes.

## 4. Our Legal Reasons for Using Information

Depending on where you live, privacy laws may require us to explain the legal reasons for handling personal information.

Where those requirements apply, we generally rely on the following:

**Legitimate business interests:** We need certain information to answer enquiries, operate our website, and maintain its security.

**Providing services:** If you ask us to discuss a project or become a client, we may need your information to prepare for or fulfil our agreement.

**Legal responsibilities:** Sometimes we must keep or share certain information to comply with applicable laws.

**Your consent:** For some activities, such as optional cookies where consent is required, we will ask for your permission.

If we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it when applicable.

We aim to use personal information only when we have a valid reason to do so.

## 5. Cookies and Website Preferences

Cookies are small files that websites can store on your device.

Our website may use cookies to support basic functions and remember certain preferences, including your privacy choices.

These cookies can help the website work as expected when you return.

You can manage or remove cookies through your browser settings. Keep in mind that disabling certain cookies may affect how parts of the website function.

Where required by law, we will ask for your permission before using non-essential cookies.

For more information, please see our **Cookie Policy** at `/cookies/`.

## 6. Who Can Access Your Information

We do not share your information unnecessarily.

However, some information may need to be accessible to people or service providers who help us run our business.

This may include:

- **Our team:** Employees or leadership members who need your information to respond to your enquiry or work on your project.
- **Website and hosting providers:** Companies that support our website infrastructure and help keep it running.
- **Email service providers:** Services that help deliver or process communications sent through our website.
- **Professional advisers:** Legal or other professional advisers when their assistance is necessary.
- **Public authorities:** Government agencies or other authorities when disclosure is required by applicable law.

We limit information sharing to what is reasonably necessary for these purposes.

We do not share one client's confidential project information with another client, and we do not sell personal information to third parties.

Where outside providers handle information on our behalf, we aim to work with providers that apply appropriate privacy and security safeguards.

## 7. How Long We Keep Your Information

We do not want to keep personal information longer than necessary.

How long we retain information depends on why it was collected.

For example:

- **General enquiries:** We keep messages for as long as reasonably needed to respond and manage the conversation.
- **Project and client communications:** If an enquiry becomes an active project, we may keep related records throughout the engagement and for a reasonable period afterwards.
- **Website technical logs:** These may be kept for shorter periods based on our hosting provider's settings and operational needs.

Sometimes, legal or business requirements mean we need to retain certain records for longer.

When information is no longer needed, we aim to delete it or handle it securely.

You can also contact us to request deletion of your personal information. We will review your request in line with applicable laws and any legitimate reasons we may need to retain certain records.

## 8. Keeping Your Information Secure

We take the security of information shared with us seriously.

Access to messages and business information is limited to people who need that information to carry out their work.

We aim to use appropriate technical and organisational measures to reduce the risk of information being accessed, changed, disclosed, or lost without authorisation.

Our public website should use HTTPS to help protect information transmitted between your browser and our website.

Even with reasonable safeguards in place, no website or online communication system can guarantee complete security.

For that reason, we recommend that you avoid sending highly sensitive information, such as passwords, payment card details, government identification numbers, or medical records, through standard website forms.

If your project involves confidential documents or sensitive business information, please contact us first so we can discuss a more suitable way to share it.

## 9. Your Privacy Rights

We believe you should have a clear understanding of the information we hold about you.

Depending on your location and applicable privacy laws, you may have the right to:

- Ask what personal information we hold about you
- Request a copy of your information
- Correct information that is inaccurate or incomplete
- Request deletion of information we no longer need
- Ask us to limit certain uses of your information
- Object to certain types of processing
- Withdraw consent where we rely on it
- Request the transfer of eligible information where required by law

Some rights are subject to legal conditions or exceptions.

If you live in a U.S. state with applicable consumer privacy legislation, additional rights may be available.

If you are located in the European Economic Area or United Kingdom, you may also have rights under applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR or UK GDPR where those laws apply.

You may also be entitled to raise concerns with a relevant data protection authority.

### How to make a privacy request

Please email **{{COMPANY_EMAIL}}** with the subject line "Privacy Request."

Tell us what you would like to know, change, or delete.

We may ask for reasonable information to confirm your identity before processing certain requests. This helps prevent personal information from being disclosed to someone who should not have access to it.

We will review your request and respond in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

## 10. Information Shared Across Borders

JUSASOL operates from the United States.

If you visit our website from another country or contact us from outside the United States, the information you share may be processed or stored in the United States.

Privacy laws can differ between countries.

Where international data protection rules apply, we will take appropriate steps to meet the relevant legal requirements, including using suitable safeguards when required.

## 11. Children's Privacy

Our website and services are designed for businesses and people contacting us for professional purposes.

They are not intended for children under the age of 16.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16 through our website.

If you believe a child has shared personal information with us, please email **{{COMPANY_EMAIL}}**.

We will review the situation and take appropriate action, including deleting the information where required.

## 12. Links to Other Websites

Our website may occasionally include links to websites or services operated by other companies.

These websites have their own privacy practices, which may be different from ours.

We are not responsible for how independent third-party websites collect or use your information.

Before sharing personal information with another website, we recommend reviewing its Privacy Policy.

## 13. Updates to This Privacy Policy

As our business and website develop, we may need to update this Privacy Policy.

For example, we may make changes when we introduce new website features, update our services, change how information is handled, or respond to new legal requirements.

When we make changes, we will publish the updated policy here and change the **Last Updated** date at the top of the page.

If a change requires additional notice or consent under applicable law, we will take the necessary steps.

We encourage you to check this page occasionally to stay informed.

## 14. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, want to understand how your information is handled, or would like to make a privacy-related request, please contact us.

**JUSASOL**

204 West Charleston Avenue
Swannanoa, NC 28778
United States

**Email:** {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}
**Phone:** {{COMPANY_PHONE}}

We value the trust you place in us and aim to handle your information responsibly, transparently, and with respect.
